name: Anneliese Baumgartner
bio:
Anneliese's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, not through a burning passion for racing, but through a deep-seated fascination with precision engineering. After completing her apprenticeship as a machinist in Zurich, she spent years honing her skills in various manufacturing industries, always seeking projects that demanded the utmost accuracy and attention to detail. A chance encounter with a former racing engineer sparked her interest in the demanding world of motorsport, where the smallest imperfection can mean the difference between victory and defeat.

Joining CLRT by Almeras was a pivotal moment for Anneliese. She thrives on the challenge of crafting and maintaining the intricate components that keep the team's Porsche 911s running at peak performance. Anneliese's approach is methodical and uncompromising, prioritizing quality and reliability above all else. She is known for her unwavering commitment to her craft and her relentless pursuit of perfection. What sets Anneliese apart is her ability to blend traditional machining techniques with innovative solutions, ensuring that the team's equipment is always at the cutting edge.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly bobbed, with a side parting.
physical.description: Anneliese is a woman of average height with a sturdy build that reflects years spent working with heavy machinery.

quirks: Always carries a small magnifying glass to inspect her work.
Insists on using only Swiss-made tools.
Has a habit of humming classical music while working.
